title: The Stop check refuses a failure that names no test instead of calling it pre-existing
body:
Why: scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts:442-457 drops a nameless '<run>::exit N' failure when the base fails the same way (lead-verified); a missing tool or broken install at both ends passes the gate. D1.
Evidence: .krn/runs/state-review/decisions.md (state review 2026-11-13, Fable 5.2; data verified by the lead where noted), .krn/runs/state-review/portability-probe.md.
